capabilities: publish a note as a webpage and copy the link
preview templates and themes locally before publishing
update an existing share URL when the note is saved
write share_link and share_updated to note frontmatter
disambiguation: Not a whole-vault publishing tool like Obsidian Publish; it shares individual notes as standalone pages hosted by a third-party service.
extras: Publishing sends the note's Markdown and referenced local images to the htmlto.link server; guest shares expire after 24 hours and the service does not provide end-to-end encryption. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in one-click way to share an individual note as a public webpage with a stable URL.

relations.evidence: Instantly share any Obsidian note as a beautiful webpage via htmlto.link and copy the public link.

requires.name: htmlto.link API token for account-bound longer-lived shares

summary: Publishes a single note as a styled webpage on htmlto.link and copies the public link, with 30+ templates and update-on-save syncing.
